continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion is traveling through Nanman under Namho's guidance toward the Nanman Beast Palace.
The Nanman Beast Palace Quest is Grade Supreme Peak, restricted to Jin Taekyung and Fire Dragon Pavilion members, with the mission to arrive at the palace still incomplete at chapter's end.
The party must conceal its identities until reaching the Nanman Beast Palace because Nanman's non-Han peoples are hostile toward Han Chinese and Dark Heaven may accelerate its plans if alerted.
The Beast Miao King, lord of the Nanman Beast Palace, participated in the Great Faction War and is believed to favor Jeok Cheongang and the Fire Gate Clan.
Dark Heaven is targeting Nanman, and Taekyung believes the coming disaster and rift are only a matter of time.
plot: Namho agrees to lead the Fire Dragon Pavilion toward the Nanman Beast Palace, activating the Nanman Beast Palace Chain Quest. The party travels covertly through Nanman's hostile jungles, where Hyuk Mujin is repeatedly poisoned and Taishan survives eating lethal blood-feeding fungus. They avoid the non-Han peoples and conceal their identities because Dark Heaven is believed to be targeting Nanman. After crossing Ailao Mountain and traveling for four days, they finally see the Nanman Beast Palace through the clouds and mist.
translation_decisions: Preserve the dry, teasing banter between Jin Taekyung and Namho during the journey.

active_continuity: The Fire Dragon Pavilion is traveling through Nanman under Namho's guidance toward the Nanman Beast Palace.
The Nanman Beast Palace Quest is Grade Supreme Peak and requires Jin Taekyung and the Fire Dragon Pavilion to arrive at the palace.
The Quest's reward is an unknown Chain Quest.
The party has reached the vicinity of the Nanman Beast Palace after crossing Ailao Mountain and traveling for four days.
The party is concealing its identities because Nanman's non-Han peoples are hostile toward Han Chinese.
Dark Heaven is targeting Nanman, and Taekyung believes a catastrophe involving the rift is imminent.
The Beast Miao King participated in the Great Faction War and is believed to favor Jeok Cheongang and the Fire Gate Clan.
open_questions: Was the woman in the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group the Southern Heaven Demon Empress?
Who poisoned and killed the Heavenly Demon Escort Bureau group, and why?
What catastrophe will Dark Heaven cause in Nanman?
What dangers and response await the Fire Dragon Pavilion inside the Nanman Beast Palace?
temporary_decisions: Render 南琥, Namho's code name, as Namho rather than translating it literally as southern amber.
Use Elder Chao for the local title 챠오 어르신.
